fields.description: Fetch: a report/page triggered this (cache hit or a real PeopleSoft call). Warm-up: budget_mis.startup.warm_actuals_cache's post-login pre-fetch.
fields.label: Call Type

fields.description: Hit: served from frappe.cache() with no PeopleSoft call. Miss (fetched): cache was empty/expired, a real PeopleSoft HTTP call ran. Skipped: a Warm-up entry the logging-in user's own module access didn't require.
fields.label: Cache Result

fields.description: Wall-clock time for this call, in milliseconds. Near-zero for a cache hit; up to ~120000 (120s) for a cold PeopleSoft fetch.
fields.label: Duration (ms)

fields.description: The function this call came through, e.g. get_actuals_from_erp_month_wise, group_actuals_ytd.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: Warm-up entries only: which App Module Setting(s) justified fetching (or would have justified fetching, for a Skipped entry) this period.
fields.label: Modules

fields.description: The user whose action caused this call - the logged-in user for a Fetch, or the user who just logged in for a Warm-up entry.
fields.label: Triggered By
